name: e2e
description: End-to-end test agent skills, grafted from sonhyrd/e2e-skills as an editable git subtree. pw-prove: prove a PR/branch/ticket/diff with a Playwright E2E test, fast. e2e-reviewer: static review of Playwright/Cypress specs and Page Objects, catching tests that pass CI but prove nothing. pw-prove is user-invocable only; e2e-reviewer is model-invocable so pw-prove can chain into it at its quality gate.
